# pi-glance 0.7.2

- Present Pi's Working, compaction, branch-summary and retry activity inside the Glance frame, without a separate progress row.
- Add Text and Sweep activity modes. Text is the new default; Sweep uses normal motion for Working, an adjustable speed multiplier for summaries, and an adjustable border blink for retries.
- Expand `/glance` Activity settings and preview with effect area, speed, color, summary multiplier, retry blink rate and transient example states. Existing navigation and explicit save/cancel behavior remain unchanged.
- Count standalone Pi usage entries such as cache warming in Tokens and Cost, while leaving Context and Model speed semantics unchanged.
- Align the full-width settings preview with Pi 0.86's zero-height empty footer in regular and fullscreen modes. Existing input, cursor and draft state remain mounted.
- Upgrade the configuration schema to 15. Older configurations open in Text mode while retaining their saved sweep area, speed and color; only an explicit Save writes the migration.
- Requires Pi 0.86.1 or newer and Node.js 22.19.0 or newer.
